statements: Use Voltage API in developer contexts and Voltage for the product; do not brand the skill Voltage Payments.
Credit-backed is the easiest and recommended starting point for most customers; agents explain applicability and do not decide for the customer.
Use ~/.voltage/ as a local configuration convention; this is not an API contract requirement.
